channel.name: 03 HL7v2 to Patient - OieMessage
channel.description: Unprocessed RAW source; five independent destinations receive the same ORU^R01: standard HL7 v2, HL7 v2 Strict Parser, prepared XML, prepared JSON and prepared text. Each destination runs inline FML to produce an R4 Patient without an IG. POST /oru-patient/ on port 10800; the standard pipeline supplies the HTTP response.
